name: novel-intake
description: Convert an author brainstorm into a constrained, schema-valid Story Brief.
procedure: Extract only author-supplied intent, promises, constraints, and unresolved decisions.
Resolve harmless omissions conservatively and preserve material ambiguity as an open question.
Persist one Story Brief and observable evidence.
Choose the next step from the author's goal and current project state; keep progress in project docs and verify persisted tool results.
